summary: Full E2E verification of the new PARTIAL refund flow (deposit minus EUR 300 commission), the commission-swallows-deposit edge case, the ReserveCar terms gate, the BodyDiagram in three languages (car 42179408) plus its clean-state (42379471), and the /api/deposit/car regression that exposes commission_eur. Two real Stripe test deposits were paid and refunded end-to-end. Backend pytest: 9/9 PASSED in 93s. Frontend Playwright: all copy, gating, findings, structural chips and empty-state assertions passed in EN/BG/RO. No Korean characters anywhere in the body diagram in any language. Zero defects found.
critical_code_review_comments: deposits.refund() correctly computes give_back = max(0, amount - COMMISSION_EUR) and passes the correct partial amount to stripe.Refund.create; when give_back <= 0 it skips Stripe altogether, updates Mongo, and still frees the car. Verified live with two real Stripe test payments.

ReserveCar.js uses formatMoney(commission_eur, currency, lang, rates) for the blurb, so on the RO detail page the commission is displayed in RON (converted from EUR 300 -> ~1574 RON) rather than as '300 EUR'. This is intentional (matches how all other prices are localised) but is worth flagging: the review brief asks that the paragraph 'names the EUR 300 commission' - on /ro/car/* the amount is 1574 RON, not '300 EUR'. FAQ and Fees pages hardcode '300 EUR' in the same languages, so the two representations are consistent-for-context; no code change recommended unless the owner wants the number pinned to EUR on the reserve blurb.
PaymentResultPage.js reads commission_eur from /api/deposit/status/{sid} which now includes it - confirmed via test_deposit_status_returns_commission_eur.

seed_data_creation: Two refunded deposit rows are kept as history (see traceability). No paid deposits or reserved cars remain. Cars 42370582 and 42462841 are both released and re-reservable. A pending checkout session for 42370582 (created by test_different_buyer_can_reserve_after_partial_refund) is cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refund flow now correctly issues a PARTIAL Stripe refund of (deposit - 300 EUR). The pytest file test_partial_refund_and_commission.py drives Stripe hosted Checkout with Playwright for two paid deposits, then verifies API + Stripe Refund object + Mongo + car release. The edge case is exercised by patching deposits.amount to 250 in Mongo BEFORE calling refund; the endpoint returns returned_eur=0, commission_eur=250, no Stripe refund is created, and the car is released. Cars used: 42370582 (partial), 42462841 (edge). If you re-run, they must be free - check GET /api/deposit/car/{id} first. Chromium is under /pw-browsers.

partial_refund.note: PARTIAL refund confirmed by Stripe API: amount_refunded=31990c (=deposit 61990c - 30000c commission), charge.refunded=false (only 100% refunds flip it to true), exactly one Refund object on the intent.

commission_swallows_deposit_edge_case.note: As instructed the paid deposit's `amount` field was set to 250 in Mongo before pressing refund. deposits.refund() took the give_back <= 0 branch, did NOT call stripe.Refund.create (verified via stripe.Refund.list count unchanged), still flipped the record to refunded and $unset the reserved fields on the listing.

reserve_blurb_mentions_300.ro: 1.574 RON (i.e. EUR 300 converted; FAQ/fees show 300 EUR hardcoded)

rca of the issue: No issue - iteration_28 verified the previous FULL refund behaviour; this iteration verifies the deliberate switch to PARTIAL (deposit - 300) which is now working end-to-end (Stripe Refund object correctly sized to 31990 cents on a 61990-cent charge).
